hints.title: Target Reduction Quantity
hints.text: The objective is to reduce the initial sum of nums by at least sum(nums) / 2.

hints.title: Greedy Halving Choice
hints.text: To minimize the count of operations, each step must choose the current maximum element to halve.

hints.title: Priority Queue Maintenance
hints.text: A max-heap supports extracting the largest value and inserting its halved value in logarithmic time.

hints.title: Max-Heap Halving Loop
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Solution:
    def halveArray(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        pq = [-float(x) for x in nums]
        heapq.heapify(pq)
        target = sum(nums) / 2.0
        reduced = 0.0
        ops = 0
        while reduced < target:
            top = -heapq.heappop(pq)
            half = top / 2.0
            reduced += half
            heapq.heappush(pq, -half)
            ops += 1
        return ops
```

complexity.notes: Building the heap takes O(n) and each halving step takes O(log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-sorting the array on each halving operation takes O(n^2 log n) and TLEs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Max heap requires O(n) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes max heap priority queue and maintains floating-point precision.
